findings: Required run identity, main push origin, six exact successful jobs and all named validation/package steps are checked before any release mutation.

Audition verification requires exact calibrated inventory,24 named programs,117seconds,32 hashes, actual WAV structure and samples, and factory parameter/controller/timing identity.
Cross-origin redirects remove authorization; mutation redirects fail. Artifact members are bounded and not executed.
Only documentation and three explicitly named publisher files may differ from binary source; source ancestry and comparison truncation are guarded.
No release is created until all five artifact payloads verify. Seven assets are verified before a draft becomes public; existing tags/assets are never moved, deleted or replaced.
Matching published release is a no-op; matching partial draft resumes missing assets; incomplete published or mismatching existing releases are refused.
operational_notes: Keep main stable through first publication. If it advances after the event SHA was captured, the publisher intentionally refuses. A fresh workflow_dispatch uses the new SHA; rerunning the same stale event does not refresh GITHUB_SHA.
GitHub token permission success, final-run artifacts and public release GET checks remain operational gates. No future run or unrelated release is authorized by this fixed workflow.
